entries.descriptionText:
---
The Black Pine Cave System Collective Map, 1912, painstakingly put together through all the collective efforts of the Honey Dew Caving Club from 1902-1911.  Special mention to the main contributor Thomas O'Rourke who tragically lost his life in 1911 abseiling in France was the main contributor, and the founder of the Caving Club.
